messages.subject: Infrastructure & Sustainability Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Lord,

Your executive-search work across capital programs, energy, utilities and sustainability aligns with my international leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where infrastructure and energy development require regulatory coordination, stakeholder trust and responsible execution. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
